offers.name: MSI Vector A16 HX 16" 240Hz Gaming Laptop - AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX - 32GB RAM - 1TB SSD - GeForce RTX 5080 - Win11 Home - Cosmo Grey

reviews.quote: The power supply is particularly hefty in both size and weight, and would be more appropriate for a notebook featuring an RTX 5080 or 5090.

praises: RTX 5080 16GB for $3,599 direct from MSI at Best Buy — the cheapest 5080 laptop in Canada at check time
16-core Ryzen 9 8940HX: workstation-class multicore for rendering/compiles alongside gaming
16GB GDDR7 handles 1440p-ultra and 4K with DLSS without VRAM limits (5070 Ti's 12GB is the pinch point)
Same sturdy Vector chassis: two M.2 + two SO-DIMM, TB4 + 2.5G Ethernet
NBC: the Vector's PSU was sized for 5080-class GPUs — this tier finally uses that headroom
complaints: Audible fan at idle in AI mode until curves retuned (Vector-line gripe, NBC + owners)
Very heavy 330W power brick — total travel weight approaches 3.5kg
AMD variant lacks the Intel model's dual Thunderbolt 5 (USB4/TB4 only)
Unconventional keyboard layout, limited lid opening angle (NBC)
No sale price — full $3,599 while 5070 Ti siblings discount below $3,000

design_philosophy: MSI's Vector formula: chassis and cooling borrowed from the step-up tier, previous-gen AMD HX CPU used to fund a bigger GPU. This is the line's performance flagship in Canada — 5080 + 16-core Zen 4 at a price most rivals charge for a 5070 Ti.
rating_notes: No direct pro review for the AMD Vector A16. Inferred from NBC Vector 16 HX AI 5070 Ti review (84%, SHARED-msi-katana-vector.md): 5080 tier → gaming +0.8, ai_ml +1.0 (16GB VRAM), creative_work +0.5; 8940HX 16c → productivity +0.5; battery −0.5 vs 5070 Ti tier; TB4 not TB5 → port_connectivity −1.0 vs Intel anchor.
